messages:
joan-cs: Quick alert: Beaconly (acct beacon-77) reported steady 429s from our embeddings endpoint during k8s scale-up. They say it started after HPA kicked from 2->20 pods during a canary import job.
mike-dev: can you paste the node client init + auth flow? any sidecars doing token minting?
joan-cs: they use node-sdk v1.2.0, each pod spawns 10 worker threads that create clients on startup. token flow: sidecar exposes /token with short-lived JWTs, all pods call it at container start. snippet they shared:
```js
// app startup (each worker)
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'eu-west-1', keepAlive: false, maxParallelInit: 20 });
await client.prefetch(); // we call this to warm caches
```
logs: `2026-03-20T15:02:03Z WARN embeddings 429 rate_limit route=/v1/embeddings tenant=beacon-77 retry_after=2s`
talia-sre: sounds like synchronized warmups across many pods + keepAlive disabled causing thousands of short-lived connections and token validation spikes. Two levers: reduce concurrent client inits and enable HTTP keep-alive / connection reuse.
joan-cs: customer says they intentionally create client per worker for isolation. Any immediate mitigations we can suggest?
mike-dev: immediate checklist: 1) toggle sidecar to issue splayed token TTLs (randomize expiry +/-10s), 2) set keepAlive: true in our Node SDK so TCP connections are reused, 3) drop maxParallelInit to 2-4 per worker or share a single client per pod, 4) add client-side exponential backoff with jitter on 429.
quota-bot: RW-TICKET-13021 opened: "beacon-77 onboarding embeddings 429 on k8s scale-up" assigned to infra-onboard.
infra-onboard: we can also enable tenant-level preflight coalesce for 12h and temporary +50% rate window for onboarding. both require ops approval.
talia-sre: longer term: add k8s onboarding doc section recommending a) reuse client at pod level b) readinessProbe stagger startDelay c) HPA startupWarmup annotation to ramp pods slowly. I'll draft a runbook snippet.
joan-cs: passed mitigation list to customer; they changed to shared client per pod, enabled keepAlive, added splay to token TTL, and reduced prefetch calls.
mike-dev: results?
joan-cs: after changes, 10-minute observation: 429s dropped to near zero during similar scale tests. They're happy and asked for a short note to include in onboarding guide.
talia-sre: I'll add a k8s page and link the ticket. Also follow-up: consider defaulting SDK keepAlive to true in next minor if we keep seeing this pattern.
mike-dev: agreed. I'll open a docs PR and a small SDK issue to add example for pod-level client reuse.
joan-cs: closing once infra flips the temporary rate window. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
